tags.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE - columnar projection (2 columns of a wide table)
tags.concept: Parquet columnar reads: only referenced columns are fetched
tags.question: How many bytes are read when a query touches 2 of the 22 columns of raw_agent_events?
tags.interpretation: raw_value (full JSON) dominates the table size; queries that do not reference it skip those column chunks entirely. Compare physical input bytes with exp_tier_raw_json, which must read raw_value.
